title: Envelopes · Standard branding
slide_intent: Separate sender information from the delivery address. Consistent placement makes the envelope recognizable before the letter is opened.
strategic_value: An upper-left signature can identify Special Olympics across envelope sizes while leaving the window area available for the recipient.
demonstration: A window envelope is paired with enlargements of the two-line mark, vertical separator and sender address. One enlargement shows the address on multiple lines.
practical_value: Use the 13 mm mark 10 mm from the top and left. Set a 0.5 pt gray separator about 5 mm to its right, then set the address in 8 pt Ubuntu on 11 pt spacing.

content_islands.name: Placement notes
content_islands.spec: Number the settings for the mark, symbol inset, separator, typography and multiline option in the left column.

content_islands.name: Envelope and enlarged details
content_islands.spec: Place the complete window envelope below the two circular enlargements. Use blue guides to connect sender placement on the envelope to its construction details.
